scope: Owned existing-depot stock-to-private G1 migration-refusal rehearsal; NOT stock recovery behavior, deployment readiness, or G1 signoff

scenario.stockSeed: Two case-insensitive ordinary public signups while the owned SMTP container was stopped both returned HTTP 424 and created two distinct pending legacy identities in the stock depot; neither client obtained a session.
scenario.prototypeStartup: After stock server shutdown, the exact-patch-verified private binary attempted the same depot and exited before health/readiness with the ambiguous-identity preflight CHECK constraint failure.

postFailureAssertions.sqliteOptimizerMetadata: PRAGMA optimize created only sqlite_stat1 and sqlite_stat4 at startup; these SQLite-owned statistics tables were explicitly recorded and excluded from application-schema comparison

attemptHistory: Run 1: full snapshot comparison failed because it treated SQLite optimizer statistics as auth migration schema; refusal and owned cleanup were observed.
Run 2: field-only diagnostic localized the delta to SQLite schema metadata; user rows, migration history and temporary schema matched.
Run 3: schema-object-name set comparison failed; changed names were not printed to evidence.
Run 4: private diagnostic identified only sqlite_stat1 and sqlite_stat4, created by TrailBase connection initialization's PRAGMA optimize.

Run 5: final assertion compares application schema SQL, pending user rows and migration history exactly, and separately requires exactly those two optimizer-stat additions; both tests passed and cleanup passed.

tests.name: stock TrailBase can leave ambiguous legacy pending identities in an existing depot
private G1 migration refuses ambiguous existing identities without changing rows, schema or history

limitations: One owned macOS SQLite depot with two case-insensitive duplicate pending identities; no Linux/browser/PostgreSQL or multi-server run.
SQLite optimizer statistics are an ordinary startup side effect, explicitly distinguished from the auth/application schema and included here rather than hidden.
No backup/restore or repeated migration restart rehearsal; those remain pending.
This is a private source prototype test only; no stock/candidate recovery result changes.
explicitNonClaims: No stock v0.34.3 G1 recovery fix, release build or deployment approval.
